"""design_E6D6 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징 테이블과 분할 배정만 만든다 (학습·전처리 적합 없음).

설계 문제로 보류/수정한 부분은 REPORT.md 참고:
  - 진단 특징(n_dx, dx_ckd, dx_chf)은 설계에 시간 범위가 없어 '해당(index) 입원'으로 한정해 계산(잠정).
  - 분할 키 family_id 결측(약 80%)은 patient_id로 대체한 그룹 키 사용(잠정).
  - 전처리(median_impute 포함)는 적합하지 않음. 적합 시 반드시 train에서만.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

D = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["report_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# 결과: 퇴원(tp) 후 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 같은 환자의 다음 입원 시작
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]
a["next_admit_time"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a.next_admit_time > a.tp) & (a.next_admit_time <= a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
data_end = a["discharge_time"].max()
a["fu_complete_30d"] = a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30) <= data_end
a["n_prior_adm"] = a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()

# 코호트
c = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
c = c[(c.age >= 18) & (c.discharge_status != "died")].copy()

# 특징
c["los_h"] = (c.discharge_time - c.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 열이 없어 계산


def lab_agg(test, how):
    x = labs[labs.test == test].merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    x = x[(x.report_time >= x.admit_time) & (x.report_time <= x.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    return x.groupby("admission_id")["value"].agg(how)


c["cr_last"] = c.admission_id.map(lab_agg("creatinine", "last"))
c["hgb_min"] = c.admission_id.map(lab_agg("hemoglobin", "min"))

o = orders[orders.order_type == "dialysis_order"].merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
o = o[(o.order_time >= o.admit_time) & (o.order_time <= o.tp)]
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c.admission_id.isin(o.admission_id).astype(int)

# 진단: 잠정적으로 index 입원 범위로 한정 (설계는 범위 미지정 → 미래 입원 진단 누출 위험)
g = dx.assign(ckd=dx.icd_code.str.startswith("N18"), chf=dx.icd_code.str.startswith("I50")).groupby("admission_id")
c["n_dx"] = c.admission_id.map(g.size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
c["dx_ckd"] = c.admission_id.map(g["ckd"].any()).fillna(False).astype(int)
c["dx_chf"] = c.admission_id.map(g["chf"].any()).fillna(False).astype(int)

# 분할: family_id 그룹 홀드아웃, 결측은 patient_id로 대체 (잠정)
c["split_group"] = c.family_id.fillna(c.patient_id)
groups = np.sort(c.split_group.unique())
rng = np.random.default_rng(20261002)
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(0.3 * len(groups))), replace=False))
c["split"] = np.where(c.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp", "fu_complete_30d",
        "readmit_30d", "unit", "cr_last", "n_dx", "dialysis_ordered", "dx_ckd", "discharge_status",
        "los_h", "sex", "dx_chf", "hgb_min", "n_prior_adm", "age"]
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "cohort_features.csv", index=False)

print("cohort", len(c), "patients", c.patient_id.nunique(), "readmit rate", round(c.readmit_30d.mean(), 4))
print(c.groupby("discharge_status").agg(n=("readmit_30d", "size"), rate=("readmit_30d", "mean"),
                                         fu_complete=("fu_complete_30d", "mean")))
print(c.groupby("split").agg(n=("readmit_30d", "size"), rate=("readmit_30d", "mean"), pts=("patient_id", "nunique")))
print("missing:", c[["cr_last", "hgb_min"]].isna().sum().to_dict())
print("patient overlap train/test:", len(set(c[c.split == "train"].patient_id) & set(c[c.split == "test"].patient_id)))
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/ddb513d1d126-t1/ws && python3 prep/build_dataset.py
